basis: Mark 3 Owner direction and existing Mark 2 evidence; selected additional primary findings are in companion-review.json. This plan contains no experiment result.

controls: Direct eligible harness/workflow as an experimental baseline
Lean configured platform with required capability available for explicit activation
Rich configured platform with relevant capabilities active
evidence_requirements: Competing concrete approaches and reuse/adaptation/new implementation rationale
Current primary documentation plus pinned implementation paths and licenses/terms where applicable
Explicit assumptions, applicability limits and contradictory evidence
Same contract and failure corpus with recorded version/config/host/resource bounds
Measured observations or preregistered unrun comparisons, with denominators and uncertainty
Reasoned disposition and decisive next test; topic count or agent count is not depth
comparison_protocol.bounds: Reuse eight families and matched tasks; select discriminating cases and broaden only on counterexamples. Do not treat repeated attempts as independent tasks.

areas.label: System performance
areas.question: Where should active work live so capability growth does not impose equivalent idle cost?
approaches: Single deterministic service with lazy optional modules
Bounded subprocess workers activated on demand
Resident service pool with measured reuse
failure_cases: Shared-process contention delays Stop
Worker startup dominates short tasks
Disabled imports create background I/O
metrics: p50/p95/p99 input-to-feedback and completion latency per task
CPU time, peak/idle RSS, I/O bytes, network bytes, wakeups per observation interval
areas.disposition_rule: Change placement when a same-capability alternative meets correctness/control floors and improves the reported workflow vector; do not infer a universal hardware minimum.

areas.label: Cache performance
areas.question: Which reuse and compaction policy preserves current intent and actually helps completion on each eligible route?
approaches: No keepalive; reconstruct from authoritative state
Supported prefix retention plus validated evidence retrieval
Bounded refresh/warm-session policy when eligible
failure_cases: Revoked instructions survive cached continuation
Warm work is charged but never reused
Compaction omits an accepted requirement
metrics: Cache writes/hits/misses and expiry by exact route
Complete tokens/quota/money and human corrections per accepted task
Continuation latency and requirement retention by warm/cold/no-future-work condition
areas.disposition_rule: Reject a reuse policy that preserves stale authority or hides charges; choose configurable route-specific defaults only after full-workflow evidence.

areas.label: Configuration
areas.question: How can rich composition and live revisions remain understandable and enforceable across dormant and active sessions?
approaches: Immutable effective snapshots with explicit new-session propagation
Revision subscription plus field-specific safe application boundaries
Layered profiles/plugins compiled into a validated effective configuration
failure_cases: Child spawn races revision/revocation
A displayed setting differs from the effective setting
Resume loses custom tools or runtime options
metrics: Revision propagation and validation latency per affected session
Owner time/errors identifying effective settings
Conflict frequency and explanation accuracy per configuration change
areas.disposition_rule: Preserve both accepted propagation modes; choose merge/lifecycle mechanisms using counterexamples and user comprehension, not raw option count.

areas.label: Compatibility
areas.question: Which supported interface combinations realize the same accepted behavior across native, upstream-only and combined routes?
approaches: Native implementation behind common contracts
Supported upstream SDK/server/protocol plus extensions
Explicit adaptation layer with declared semantic losses
failure_cases: Wrapper-only assumptions miss richer interfaces
Unmodified binary and redistribution permissions diverge
A helper silently requires a different API key
metrics: Required-control conformance per exact route/build/config/host
Unknown/refused/unsupported cells kept distinct
Complete task, failed-attempt and auxiliary accounting per route
areas.disposition_rule: Keep all 13 entries and seven critical names; missing meaningful compatibility becomes an evidenced Owner release tradeoff rather than silent scope reduction.

areas.label: Agent communication
areas.question: Which consultation and conversation design reduces coordination burden while retaining attribution, control and coherent goals?
approaches: Head-relayed attributable consultation
Direct addressed consultation with canonical event receipts
Shared discussion with explicit participant roles and one decision holder
failure_cases: Advice is mistaken for a grant
Cyclic consultations exhaust the shared pool
Revoked or stale replies alter accepted intent
metrics: Owner intervention/repeated-explanation counts per completed workflow
Time to understand/adopt/reject a consultation
Coordination backlog, decision provenance completeness, quality and total consumption
areas.disposition_rule: Communication remains required; compare topology and activation. The direct-harness no-specialist baseline is an experimental control, not a reduced release.

areas.label: CLI performance and terminal multiplexing
areas.question: How can multiple attachable views remain responsive and control one durable execution without owning it?
approaches: Single event stream with independent per-view cursors
Bounded per-view projections with replay and snapshot recovery
Local projection caches backed by authoritative sequence/cursor checks
failure_cases: A slow view backpressures Stop
Two terminals duplicate an operation
Detach or reconnect starts a second execution
metrics: Input/render latency and frame/backlog behavior per view
Attach/reconnect latency versus retained history
Owner time and errors inspecting state, steering and issuing Stop
areas.disposition_rule: Reject any topology that gives a view execution ownership or hides uncertainty; compare responsive views under bounded backpressure and accessibility tasks.

areas.label: Autonomy
areas.question: How should initiative and collaboration adapt to the accepted task without weakening intent or adding repetitive approvals?
approaches: Collaborative profile with explicit interaction checkpoints
Autonomous research profile within accepted limits
Configurable hybrid profile with evidence-triggered consequential escalation
failure_cases: Tactical replan silently changes deliverables
Routine choices repeatedly interrupt Owner
Quiet operation hides consequential scope or privacy changes
metrics: Avoidable interruptions and missed consequential escalations per workflow
Intent continuity, goal completion, Owner control and escaped defects
Human coordination/review minutes and complete model consumption
areas.disposition_rule: Retain Owner-only actual amendments; identify precise candidate classes only when representative workflows show an amendment is necessary.

areas.label: Harness orchestration
areas.question: Which admission, scheduling and session-reuse mechanisms coordinate eligible work across nodes without duplicated authority or budget?
approaches: Central deterministic scheduling with typed remote execution
Bounded per-node queues controlled by canonical leases/fences
Hybrid session reuse and on-demand workers within shared reservations
failure_cases: A returning node executes expired work
A provider reset recreates recovery funds
Warm auxiliary routing bypasses a parent cap
metrics: Queue wait and admitted/completed tasks per workload
Reserved/committed/unknown consumption by role and shared pool
Transfer volume, fairness, recovery and Owner waiting time
areas.disposition_rule: Choose placement and reuse only within explicit eligibility, privacy and aggregate limits; unknown counters never imply free or unlimited capacity.

areas.label: Headless architecture and kernels
areas.question: Can the accepted aggregate/refinement split cover every execution obligation with less complexity than a broker-inclusive model?
approaches: Small aggregate plus independently checked broker refinement
Bounded broker directly inside the first model
Framework-based timer/actor mechanisms adapted beneath the same canonical integrity boundary
failure_cases: An unmodeled broker race violates an aggregate rule
Client/process loss changes writer ownership
Framework state becomes competing canonical truth
metrics: Same bounded-trace coverage and counterexample detection for both models
States/transitions explored, abstraction assumptions, proof/review effort
Adapter-free boot/status/recovery and idle resource behavior in later probes
areas.disposition_rule: Start with approved split; include necessary broker state when independent checking is inadequate. Framework and language selection stay unmade.

areas.label: Plugins
areas.question: How can plugin availability, installation, activation and placement compose across harnesses without importing disabled costs or losing behavior?
approaches: Manifest-driven lazy loading in a deterministic host
Isolated plugin workers with lifecycle and dependency contracts
Harness-specific adapters for a shared capability schema
failure_cases: Installed-but-disabled plugin imports code or opens a connection
Configuration conversion silently drops behavior
Update/rollback retains stale grants or loses newest work
metrics: Disabled and active import/startup/RSS/network/model cost per plugin set
Behavioral conformance and loss disclosures per adaptation
Activation/configuration comprehension and full workflow quality
areas.disposition_rule: Preserve local execution and all four incompatibility responses. Optimize placements and defaults without deleting the required capability.

areas.label: MCPs
areas.question: How should tools, resources, prompts and host interaction share discovery, connections and authority across multiple sessions?
approaches: Per-session MCP connections and explicit capability discovery
Shared host connection with session-scoped projections and grants
Lazy discovery and activation with schema/version caches
failure_cases: A shared connection leaks another session's context
Resource/prompt content is mistaken for authority
Cancellation acknowledgment is mistaken for effect rollback
Stale discovery uses the wrong browser target or schema
metrics: Discovery/connection latency, schema bytes and retained resources per session
Correct cancellation/auth/permission behavior per endpoint
Helper calls, tokens/quota and human recovery cost per workflow
areas.disposition_rule: Verify each supported MCP surface and host responsibility; protocol naming alone does not establish privacy, permission or full plugin portability.

areas.label: Related mechanisms and interactions
areas.question: Do component choices remain coherent under combined replay, storage, update, remote, privacy and verification failures?
approaches: Reference deterministic traces with faults injected singly
Matched traces with a bounded pair of interacting faults
End-to-end workflow replay with independently assessed outcomes
failure_cases: Compaction, disk pressure and reconnect lose authoritative history
New software reads state it cannot safely resume
Verification or human review cost is shifted outside the budget
metrics: Invariant violations and ambiguous effects per faulted task
Recovery success separated into executable/history/newest-work/resumable-task outcomes
Total bytes/replay/backup cost and escaped defects per completed workflow
areas.disposition_rule: Preserve formal model then language then complete storage comparisons; use discriminating cross-area faults rather than an unbounded Cartesian product.

cross_area_cases.trigger: A revocation races cached continuation, advice and child spawn. Include classifier-conversation compaction as a source-informed case.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: New effects are fenced; cached/late advice cannot restore revoked authority; replay preserves the revision.

cross_area_cases.trigger: A slow/disconnected view competes for input while Stop and a remote completion cross. Include retained queues after abort and redirect-to-background behavior.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Views do not own execution; controls remain responsive; accepted/delivered/settled/unknown outcomes stay distinct.

cross_area_cases.trigger: Auxiliary quota becomes unavailable during specialist consultation and resume.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Every helper is accounted; no hidden API route or renewed reservation; intent and verification evidence survive.

cross_area_cases.trigger: Plugin/MCP revision or browser target changes during update and compatible rollback. Include a host that programmatically answers an approval request.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Report capability loss; no stale grant; newest work is preserved separately from executable restoration.

cross_area_cases.trigger: Compaction/checkpoint coincides with a replay gap, disk pressure and reconnect.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Canonical history, operation identity, cache invalidation and visible uncertainty stay coherent.

cross_area_cases.trigger: An installed but disabled capability is activated under a named revision.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Inactive work is bounded and measured; activation preserves required behavior and explicit eligibility/grants.

steps: Owner works with a questionnaire assistant to understand and answer questions.
Assistant consults Head directly with the relevant permitted question/context/evidence.
Head responds; assistant brings clarification back; Owner observes attributable exchange, participates, redirects or stops.
Head records exact accepted answers separately from proposals, integrates canonical research and returns evidence/next choices.
Repeat toward concrete architecture and bounded delegation, preserving goal/version/authority/provenance/accounting across models, sessions and configured nodes.

phases.output: Accepted answer dispositions, canonical corrections, complete comparative research specification and local validation.
Refresh consequential primary sources and compare concrete mechanisms for each area, preserving dissent and exact applicability.
Small eligible interface/control/accounting probes before model freeze; unrun until admitted resource packets exist.
Compare both proof formulations on the same traces; freeze only when combined coverage and independent refinement checks pass.
Compare languages on frozen vectors without a prior selection.
Compare complete storage/replay/recovery systems, then compile bounded construction packets.

parallel_research_rule: Whole-system optimization and cross-area investigation continue alongside interface/model work; the model-language-storage sequence constrains freezes and selection, not all useful research.

preconditions: Explicit bounded WorkPacket with exact input/build/config/host, parent authority, privacy, allowed effects, cleanup and gate
Available included capacity, shared budget reservations and review reserve
No installation, login, node enrollment, paid experiment or runtime migration inferred from source research
Record unknown counters and unavailable sources explicitly; no new permissions inferred
